summary: Lanvin Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited semi-annual report for the six months ended June 30, 2026, prepared under IAS 34. The filing is a routine periodic financial report, not a special-situation event. It recaps the December 2022 business combination with Primavera Capital Acquisition Corp. and confirms NYSE listing under LANV and LANV-WT. No transaction, board action, or strategic initiative is announced. The filing is incorporated by reference into existing shelf registration statements. No deal terms or activist elements are present, so it is classified as None.
